    Restriction from the standard mesh to its projective vertices #

    The manuscript's restricted Yoneda functor factors through restriction of finite contravariant modules on the whole standard mesh. On projective-injective modules this restriction is fully faithful: both sides have finite coordinates indexed by the projective mesh vertices, and restriction identifies the corresponding dual corepresentables.
